- Verify that the copilot-instructions.md file in the .github directory is created.

- Clarify Project Requirements
	- Project: Vite + React SPA
	- Pages: 題數選擇頁 / 考試頁 / 結果頁（可看錯題解析）
	- 題庫來源: src/topic/**/topic.json

- Scaffold the Project
	- Use Vite to scaffold a React (JavaScript) project in the workspace root.

- Customize the Project
	- Add routing and implement the 3 pages.
	- Implement JSON loading with import.meta.glob.
	- Provide a sample topic.json under src/topic/sample/topic.json.

- Install Required Extensions
	- None.

- Compile the Project
	- npm install
	- npm run build

- Ensure Documentation is Complete
	- README.md includes how to add topics and run dev/build.
